# LFP leads, NCM evolves: Cathode 2024 year in review

8th January 2025

Senior Editor - Supply Chains & Data Visualisation

Lithium iron phosphate (LFP) retained its dominant position in the global cathode market on strong demand from China’s stationary storage sector and fast-growing electric vehicle (EV) market in 2024.
